scenes.subtitle: Neighbours share gardens — someone with space, someone who wants to grow.

scenes.heading: An unloved garden, and someone longing to grow.
bullets: Priya has a garden she loves but can no longer manage alone.
Sam wants space to grow veg, but has none.
Lend & Tend patch-matches the two — and helps them agree how it'll work.
Here's the whole journey, from listing a garden to a signed agreement.
scenes.caption: Two neighbours, one garden — let's walk through it.
Browse gardens shared near you — each pin is a garden looking for a tender.
Listing a garden takes a minute: name it, describe it, and say what you're hoping for in return.
Others find Priya's garden and open the listing to get in touch.

scenes.caption: Sam messages Priya — they chat, and agree to share the garden.
A simple agreement sets out what you'll grow and when you'll visit.
A few ground rules — pets, water, sharing produce — agreed up front.

scenes.heading: It doesn't stop at hello.
